mapper.select:
select u.username as value, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('username', u.username) as meta from ks_users u where 1 = 1 and u.is_deleted = 0 and u.status = 1
and (u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.id desc

select u.username as value, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) as label, (case when u.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('username', u.username) as meta from ks_users u where u.is_deleted = 0 and u.username in #{v}

select d.dept_code as value, d.dept_name as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('deptCode', d.dept_code) as meta from ks_departments d where 1 = 1 and d.is_deleted = 0 and d.status = 1
and (d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.dept_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by d.sort_order asc, d.id asc

select d.dept_code as value, d.dept_name as label, (case when d.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('deptCode', d.dept_code) as meta from ks_departments d where d.is_deleted = 0 and d.dept_code in #{v}

select a.id as value, a.name as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('appCode', a.app_code) as meta from kb_apps a where 1 = 1 and a.is_deleted = 0 and a.status = 1
and (a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.app_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by a.id desc

select a.id as value, a.name as label, (case when a.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('appCode', a.app_code) as meta from kb_apps a where a.is_deleted = 0 and cast(a.id as char) in #{v}

select pa.code as value, concat(COALESCE(p.name, pa.provider_code), ' / ', pa.code) as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('baseUrl', pa.base_url) as meta from kb_provider_accounts pa left join kb_providers p on p.code = pa.provider_code where 1 = 1 and pa.status = 1
and (pa.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pa.provider_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by pa.code asc

select pa.code as value, concat(COALESCE(p.name, pa.provider_code), ' / ', pa.code) as label, (case when pa.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('baseUrl', pa.base_url) as meta from kb_provider_accounts pa left join kb_providers p on p.code = pa.provider_code where pa.code in #{v}

select lm.model_code as value, COALESCE(NULLIF(lm.display_name, ''), lm.model_name) as label, (case when lm.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('modelType', lm.model_type, 'modelFamily', lm.model_family, 'status', lm.status) as meta from kb_logical_models lm where lm.is_deleted = 0 and lm.model_code in #{v}

select m.model_code as value, m.model_code as label, (case when m.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('providerName', COALESCE(p.name, m.provider_account_code), 'providerAccountCode', m.provider_account_code, 'modelType', lm.model_type, 'logicalModelCode', pmm.logical_model_code, 'status', m.status) as meta from kb_models m left join kb_provider_model_mappings pmm on pmm.model_id = m.id left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = pmm.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_providers p on p.code = m.provider_account_code where m.is_deleted = 0 and m.model_code in #{v}
select mp.pool_code as value, mp.name as label, (case when mp.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled from kb_model_pools mp where mp.is_deleted = 0 and mp.pool_code in #{v}

select c.id as value, c.name as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('consumerCode', c.consumer_code) as meta from kb_routing_consumers c where 1 = 1 and c.status = 1
and (c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.consumer_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by c.id desc

select c.id as value, c.name as label, (case when c.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled, json_object('consumerCode', c.consumer_code) as meta from kb_routing_consumers c where cast(c.id as char) in #{v}
select br.code as value, br.code as label, (case when br.status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as disabled from kb_billing_rules br where br.is_deleted = 0 and br.code in #{v}

select r.id as value, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.name, ''), r.code) as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('roleCode', r.code) as meta from ks_roles r where 1 = 1
and (r.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by r.id asc
select r.id as value, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.name, ''), r.code) as label, 0 as disabled, json_object('roleCode', r.code) as meta from ks_roles r where cast(r.id as char) in #{v}

select p.code as value, concat(p.name, ' / ', p.code) as label, 0 as disabled from kb_providers p where 1 = 1
and (p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.code asc
select p.code as value, concat(p.name, ' / ', p.code) as label, 0 as disabled from kb_providers p where p.code in #{v}
